title: Movie watching and recognition memory: depth-electrode macro iEEG from Keles et al. 2024 (DANDI 000623)
description: Depth-electrode macroelectrode intracranial EEG (iEEG/SEEG) recorded from 16 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy during passive viewing of an edited Hitchcock film excerpt and a subsequent new/old recognition memory test. Contacts target the amygdala, hippocampus and medial frontal cortex and also sample lateral cortex. This is an iEEG-BIDS conversion of the macro-LFP data from the DANDI 000623 release by Keles et al. (2024), with signal values unchanged and trial, TTL and movie-frame events provided.
methods_description: Macro contacts of hybrid Behnke-Fried depth electrodes were recorded with a Neuralynx ATLAS system at 2000 Hz, low-pass filtered at 500 Hz and decimated to 1000 Hz. Participants watched an 8-min movie excerpt (encoding) and then performed a recognition test on 40 movie frames (20 seen, 20 unseen) with a 1-6 confidence rating. The NWB LFP_macro series was written to BrainVision float32 microvolts without filtering, resampling or re-referencing.
